# Jane Andrews

## Overview

- **Age:** 16 (v01:c15:p0011)  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c11 P31](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0031), [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Status:** Engaged to Edward Inglis  <sub>[v3 c39 P18](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0018), [v3 c39 P44](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0044)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 c14 P5](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0005), [v2 c28 P3](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

Jane is a plain, wholesome-looking girl who becomes neat and sensible as she grows up. She is known for having a rather fat hand and a plump figure.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059), [v3 c8 P18](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0018)_

## Personality

Jane is a practical, neat, and highly sensible girl with a matter-of-fact approach to life. Lacking in vivid imagination, she prefers straightforward logic and hard work over romantic ideals. She is conscientious, ladylike, and dependable, though she can be firm and occasionally strict in her views.

_Sources: [v1 c17 P19](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0019), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c32 P18](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0018), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059)_

- Perform her duties conscientiously and satisfy school trustees  <sub>[v2 c4 P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002)</sub>

## History

Jane Andrews grew up in Avonlea as a classmate and close friend of Anne Shirley, Diana Barry, and Ruby Gillis. She attended Queen's Academy alongside Anne, earning her teacher's license and excelling in domestic science. After graduating, she taught at the Newbridge school for two years. She later went West to teach, eventually taking a school in Winnipeg. While in the West, she met Edward Inglis, a wealthy English Winnipeg millionaire, and became engaged to him. Before leaving for her new life, she served as a matchmaker by proposing to Anne on behalf of her shy brother, Billy Andrews, though Anne declined the offer. Jane subsequently married Mr. Inglis in a lavish ceremony at her home in Avonlea and departed on a wedding tour to Europe.

_Sources: [v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 c26 P37](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0037), [v3 c8 P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c11 P1](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0001), [v3 c39 P18](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0018), [v3 c39 P35](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0035)_
